requirements.quote: Migrating a connection to a new server address mid-connection is not supported by the version of QUIC specified in this document.
requirements.condition: A connection is already in progress.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: An implementation must not migrate the connection to a new server address mid-connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A state-transition test can verify that no server-address migration occurs after the connection has been established.

requirements.quote: If a client receives packets from a new server address when the client has not initiated a migration to that address, the client SHOULD discard these packets.
requirements.condition: A client receives packets from a new server address and has not initiated migration to that address.
requirements.required_behavior: The client should discard the packets.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet-processing test can inject packets from an unrequested server address and observe whether the client discards them.
